mentions.name: Rootless systemd-nspawn lab environment
mentions.description: This setup spawns container images (fetched via skopeo) as rootless systemd-nspawn machines running in userland, with networking managed by a service that uses netkit devices to set up networks in empty network namespaces and Sommelier handling Wayland. The end goal is a laptop with an easy, secure, rootless way to build lab environments.
mentions.problem: Building lab environments on a laptop that are easy to create, secure, and rootless
mentions.audience: Local lab environments built on the author's own laptop
mentions.source_excerpt: I am trying to build a local setup where I spawn dockers (fetched via skopeo) as systemd-nspawn machines in userland (rootless), with network managed by a service that uses netkit devices to setup network in their empty network namespaces.
